_metadata.description: Code Facts ground-truth client (with filesystem fallback), service.json intent reader, and the declared-vs-actual reconcile model.

requirements.title: Derive actual surfaces from Code Facts with filesystem fallback
requirements.description: The profile client calls CodeFactsService.DescribeCodeFacts to derive actual surfaces, languages, frameworks, and artifacts; when Code Facts is unavailable it falls back to deterministic filesystem detection and sets an explicit degraded reason rather than failing silently.

validation.notes: profile/client_test.go proves the filesystem fallback runs and records a degraded reason when Code Facts is down.

requirements.title: Detect the scenario profile from code facts
requirements.description: Profile detection classifies the scenario (default react-vite/Go, api-only, unrecognized/non-Go) purely from code-facts evidence — no service.json profile field — so conformance rule selection keys off actual code shape.

validation.notes: profile/profile_test.go covers default, api-only, and unrecognized non-Go backend detection.

requirements.title: Read declared service.json intent
requirements.description: A typed intent reader parses the target service.json (ports + env vars, lifecycle steps, health checks, dependencies, freshness checks) since Code Facts does not read declared config — the declared intent is one half of the reconcile.

validation.notes: intent/intent_test.go parses ports, lifecycle steps, health checks, and dependency declarations from a fixture service.json.

requirements.title: Build the declared-vs-actual reconcile model
requirements.description: The reconcile builder pairs each surface's declared intent against its code-facts actual into a {surface → {declared, actual}} model that downstream rules consume; mismatches (declared-not-actual and actual-not-declared) are first-class.

validation.notes: reconcile/reconcile_test.go builds the per-surface reconcile model and surfaces both mismatch directions.
